title: AlignmentLabelsV2
description: Ground-truth labels for alignment benchmark cases, schemaVersion 2 (PRD §5.3). Extends the v1 expected shape with timing-feature labels (absolute onset errors, local IOI errors, phase-change count), a cascade trigger declaration, and an ambiguity domain. Labels must never be passed to the algorithm under test; the runner validates them against this schema before any engine call. Existing schemaVersion-1 cases keep their files and their imperative validator — this schema applies only to cases whose manifest entry carries labelsSchema: 2.

assignmentAmbiguous.description: True when ground truth itself cannot decide WHICH same-pitch instance was played (cross-hand unison); the pair identity is then only correct up to in-group permutation.

ambiguousPairs.description: scoreEventIds whose pair identity is ambiguous up to in-group permutation; runner counts them separately instead of as plain pairing errors.

absoluteOnsetErrorMs.description: Expected raw onset error per label pair, in pair order: performed.onsetMs - targetOnsetMs.

localIoiErrorMs.description: Expected IOI residual per adjacent label pair with positive reliable time deltas; length must be <= pairs length - 1.

phaseChangeCount.description: Expected number of distinct phase-change events derived at construction time.

cascadeTrigger.description: Declares an injected error used to measure cascade errors: everything after the trigger that is labeled clean must not gain algorithm-caused errors.
